name: Tin Top Productions LLC
tagline: A PG13 modern western drama television series meant to save the western way of life
description: Tin Top Productions is an entertainment company dedicated to producing 'Tin Top,' a modern western drama television series. The show focuses on preserving the western lifestyle through authentic storytelling involving ranchers, rodeo stars, and community leaders. Currently in pre-production, the series has already secured gear and distribution placement on HORSEpro TV.

founders.name: Shaina Zollman
founders.bio: Former Queen of the Pendleton Round Up and recognized as one of Cowgirl Magazine's 30 under 30 women in the western industry.

updates.title: Pre-production Launched
updates.body: Season 1 gear is ready and the cast features legitimate rodeo leaders and ranchers.

highlights: Cast includes former Miss Rodeo America

name: Unsmudgeable
description: Unsmudgeable is a material science startup that has developed a permanent, anti-fingerprint coating for eyewear. The company utilizes advanced polymer science to solve the age-old problem of smudged lenses without the need for constant cleaning. They have secured a Letter of Intent with Bühler Leybold Optics, a global leader in eyewear manufacturing technology.

founders.name: Swarna Shiv
founders.bio: Conducted 500+ experiments and 100 user interviews to develop proprietary coating technology alongside polymer experts.

updates.title: LOI Signed with Industry Leader
updates.body: Signed an LOI with Bühler Leybold Optics to scale production of the Unsmudgeable coating.

name: Reckless Spirits LLC
tagline: Multilingual, metaphysical best friend comedy feature film
description: Reckless Spirits is a feature film project blending comedy and metaphysical elements to tell a multilingual story of friendship. The project has received significant industry recognition, including being a NewFest New Voices Grant Semi-Finalist and receiving invites to Sundance Feature Film Labs. The production focuses on independent film excellence and diverse storytelling.

founders.name: Reckless Spirits Team
founders.bio: A group of award-winning filmmakers invited to the 2025 Sundance Feature Film Labs and AntiGravity Screenwriters Camp.

updates.title: Sundance Labs Invite
updates.body: Selected for the 2025 Sundance Feature Film Labs second round.

name: Enki
tagline: Re-skilling 1 billion people with AI and tech skills
description: Enki is an AI-powered learning platform designed to help professionals master data, AI, and technical skills. The platform serves both individuals and enterprises, providing personalized learning paths at scale. Enki is currently cash flow positive and has recently tripled its recurring revenue as it expands its footprint in the corporate training market.

founders.name: Kirill Makharinsky
founders.bio: Co-founder of Emerging Travel Group and Quid; early investor in unicorns like Calm and AngelList. Oxford Mathematics graduate.

updates.title: Revenue Milestone
updates.body: Reached $500k ARR milestone, tripling revenue over the last six months.

highlights: Tripled revenue in the last 6 months
Founded by a top UK mathematics graduate

name: EcoSave Technologies
tagline: Protecting our oceans & waterways from hazardous pollution
description: EcoSave Technologies develops EST CORE™, a proprietary hardware solution that treats wastewater at the source. By intercepting hazardous pollutants before they enter municipal waterways and oceans, EcoSave provides an industrial-grade environmental defense system. The company focuses on B2B partnerships and government infrastructure projects to scale its ecological impact.

founders.name: Joseph Dolin
founders.bio: Seasoned executive with over 30 years of sales leadership experience and a dedicated ocean conservationist.

updates.title: EST CORE™ Development
updates.body: Advanced testing of wastewater treatment technology for industrial applications.
